g2_conflict_governance.module: asset-manager/core/conflicts.mjs + CLI check-conflicts <ids> | --expert NAME (structural BLOCKED → exit 1; semantic candidates → exit 0 for human review)
g2_conflict_governance.structural: reuses selectionConflicts (duplicate names/selections, declared requires/conflicts, dependency cycles, MCP runtime ids) — not rebuilt

semantic_candidates.excludes: teaching models to resist prompt injection is NOT an override (fixture-verified)

semantic_candidates.pairing: opposing modal verbs on the SAME verb+object key; frontmatter stripped; clause separators block cross-clause matches; safety rules (never commit secrets) do not pair with frequency directives (commit fully)

g2_conflict_governance.corpus: asset-manager/tests/fixtures/conflict-corpus/ — 9 fixtures covering true positives (subagent mandate, system override, opposing directives, artifact mismatch) and the false-positive defenses (similar-description legal alternatives, security rule vs frequency directive, injection-resistance clause) plus unknown cases (unreadable skill, unreadable host rules)
g2_conflict_governance.real_corpus_regression: scanning all 51 individual skills surfaces the 4 known real subagent mandates (pptx:165, skill-creator:171/225/467) vs the repo AGENTS.md prohibition, with zero false positives after pattern tightening (the initial run's 3 false positives drove the excludes/object-key fixes — recorded in the test comments)
g2_conflict_governance.honesty: candidates only — heuristic, NOT an exhaustive guarantee (名字不同且无相对指令动词的矛盾不在覆盖内, stated in scope); unreadable files → unknowns, never a 'no conflicts' verdict; fixes never weaken user/system instruction priority

g3_source_versioning_and_drills.check_stale: CLI check-stale <project> [deployment-id|all] — deployment receipts store the skill TREE hash at deploy time; current tree hash mismatch → STALE/NEEDS_REVIEW; workflow provider mappings bind reviewed_skill_sha256 (SKILL.md hash) — mismatch → STALE. Policy: hashes are never silently recomputed to become CURRENT
drills_covered_new: skill renamed (dir+registration migrated) → old deployment references UNKNOWN 'no longer registered'
skill deleted → UNKNOWN, no fake CURRENT
new license/host re-review requirement (runtime_review_required) → preflight BLOCKED, no bypass
g3_source_versioning_and_drills.drills_reused_from_existing_suites: consecutive rollback, tampering after approval, local modification protection, three-way diff, recovery closure (lifecycle/recovery/deployment test suites)
g3_source_versioning_and_drills.no_automation: update checks are on-demand CLI invocations only; no cron jobs, no auto-update, no auto-approve (per issue scope)
